text.hero.title:
Lothel Eddie:
Opening Doors, Creating Opportunity,
Carrying the Gospel *Forward*.
text.hero.lede: Equipping, Empowering and Enabling those who carry the Gospel: Lothel Eddie works to fund and support mission work globally.
text.services.title: Born Locally. Focused Regionally. At Work Globally.
text.services.lede: We are fully transparent, completely accountable, and driven by one purpose: to further the Gospel.
text.why.title: Dirty hands carry the Gospel best..
text.why.item1.title: We fund people serving people.
text.why.item1.body: Putting resources in the hands that carry the Gospel to those most in need.
text.why.item2.title: Transparency at the foundation.
text.why.item2.body: We know the work intimately, so donors know where support goes.
text.why.item3.title: We live in the communities we serve.
text.why.item3.body: Our teams are accountable to the people around them.
text.about.title: Local roots. Global reach.
text.about.body1: Lothel Eddie is based in the South Carolina Upstate...
text.about.body2: We started Lothel Eddie because we kept seeing the same gap...
text.about.band.title: Lothel Eddie at a glance
text.about.band.item1.label: Headquarters
text.about.band.item2.label: 501c(3)
text.about.band.item2.value: Your donations are fully tax deductible
text.about.band.item3.label: Where we serve
text.about.band.item3.value: Locally in the Upstate, across the Southeast, and globally in Kenya and other distressed areas.
text.about.band.item4.label: Our focus
text.about.band.item4.value: Funding local people doing missions, equipping workers, and communications support.
